formulas.tex: \term{probability}{p_{ab}} = \frac{\term{count}{n_{ab}}}{n_a}, \quad n_{ab} = \#\{(t, i) : \term{state}{s_{t,i}} = a,\ s_{t+1,i} = b\}, \quad s_{t,i} \in \{\mathrm{HH}, \mathrm{LH}, \mathrm{LL}, \mathrm{HL}\}
formulas.ascii: p_ab = n_ab / n_a; n_ab = #{(t, i): s(t, i) = a, s(t + 1, i) = b}. s(t, i) is the local Moran quadrant of county i in period t (signs of the centred value and of the spatial lag; HH=1, LH=2, LL=3, HL=4; state 0 stays empty without significance gating). Rows without a finite value or a neighbour have no state and are counted in ignored.
